answer: Registration binds each identity to a 200-unit bond locked against one hardware attestation key, recorded once per device in a registry shared across canyon, willow and glacier nodes. A sybil attacker locks 200 units per fake identity and loses 100 percent of each bond after a 30-epoch challenge window. Splitting identities multiplies that locked cost per fake key, and any shared penalty or independent juror finding slashes every bond tied to the same device.
